title: Compact Size
text: Compact Size. When this arrived I feared it was going to be too large and take up too much counter space. But after I opened it, I was relieved that it is fairly compact. I love that it is one piece of equipment that can do several different jobs. I ordered this specifically for my daughter who is in college. She will be living in a small apartment next year that does not come with a microwave. She also wants an air fryer. This will be perfect! We tried it out over this past weekend. While it can do a lot, I found it to be a bit complicated to use. I personally would need the directions handy for every time I used it. At the minimum, I would make a cheat sheet and laminate it so I could refer to it quickly. The setting controls on the unit are straight forward. Fortunately my daughter is young and will probably pick it up quickly and not need the manual out all of the time. We cooked frozen french fries in the air fryer. We used the recommended setting/button which cooked it for 23 minutes. There was no pause in the middle to shake or stir them like our other air fryer. We also used the microwave for a few items. We were pleased with the performance. It's much quieter than our microwave.  While I did like it, I'm sort of glad that my kitchen is a good size and I can keep my simple air fryer and microwave.
